Variant is 'Goodnotes: AI Notes' while batch trackName is 'Goodnotes: KI Notizen, PDF app'; bundle ID com.goodnotesapp.x from the batch file, not checked against the store. Page is a 2026 help article dated by its content, not verified for a version.
